message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each 1‑9, one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card over to start the discard pile. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Gameplay** | 1. Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction). 2. On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches the discard pile’s **color**, **number**, or **action**. 3. If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. | | **Wild Draw Four Rules** | You may only play it if you have **no other playable card** (i.e., you cannot match the current color or number). If challenged and you were wrong, you must draw 4 cards instead of the opponent drawing 4. | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | | **Optional Variations** | • **Stacking** – allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards on top of each other.
• **Custom Rules** – e.g., “Draw Two” can be played on any card, “Reverse” can be played on any card, etc. | --- ### Quick Play Summary 1. **Setup** – Shuffle, deal 7 cards each, start discard pile. 2. **Turn** – Play a matching card or draw. 3. **Action** – Follow the effect of Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, or Wild Draw Four. 4. **UNO** – Say it when you’re down to one card. 5. **Finish** – First to empty hand wins the round; score points. 6. **Repeat** – Keep playing rounds until the target score is reached. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
